scope: Read-only source review for the weekly board and release-detail prototype.
source_status: The supplied core/release-report reference directory is untracked. Hashes bind inspected bytes.

findings.statement: The board defaults to today through seven days later. Cards sort by planned date, then release ID.
findings.consequence: Keep a weekly date range and chronological cards. Approval lanes would change the current navigation model.
findings.next_action: Keep a weekly date range and chronological cards. Approval lanes would change the current navigation model.
limits: Static source inspection does not establish deployed behavior.

findings.statement: Board cards show release ID, planned date, state, title, supervisor approvals, reviewers, and performance-testing scope.
findings.consequence: Keep title, date, state, and exceptions visible. Place reviewer details inside the selected release.
findings.next_action: Keep title, date, state, and exceptions visible. Place reviewer details inside the selected release.
limits: Performance-testing scope is not passing performance-test execution. Approval values use the exact string Yes.

findings.statement: Detail metadata includes ID, planned date, state, release approach, and nature of change.
findings.consequence: Use one compact header. Avoid empty optional fields.
findings.next_action: Use one compact header. Avoid empty optional fields.
limits: Static source inspection does not establish deployed behavior.

findings.statement: Work item rows place test execution and defect counts beside story identity and state.
findings.consequence: Retain story-level testing context. Make failed tests and open defects readable before full drill-down.
findings.next_action: Retain story-level testing context. Make failed tests and open defects readable before full drill-down.
limits: Static source inspection does not establish deployed behavior.

findings.statement: Build cards identify repository, pipeline build link, source branch, alignment check, and ADO line and branch coverage.
findings.consequence: Use repository/build as the primary technical grouping. Keep line and branch coverage distinct.
findings.next_action: Use repository/build as the primary technical grouping. Keep line and branch coverage distinct.
limits: Static source inspection does not establish deployed behavior.

findings.statement: Four commit identities are available: candidate build revision, PROD deployed revision, main tip, and candidate-branch latest tip.
findings.consequence: Show four labeled commit identities inline per repository. Include branch, short SHA, and full-SHA access.
findings.next_action: Show four labeled commit identities inline per repository. Include branch, short SHA, and full-SHA access.
limits: Static source inspection does not establish deployed behavior.

findings.statement: Existing comparison checks cover candidate versus latest, candidate versus main, candidate versus PROD, and main versus PROD.
findings.consequence: Show a compact comparison checklist with explicit direction, counts, reason, and evidence link.
findings.next_action: Show a compact comparison checklist with explicit direction, counts, reason, and evidence link.
limits: The source permits merge-comment exceptions. The prototype must not silently equate every behind count with an approved blocking rule.

findings.statement: Commit hashes sit inside nested popovers. The source displays an ideal branch relationship under the checks.
findings.consequence: Promote identities into a visible commit strip and comparison rows. Use a graph only when ancestry data supports it.
findings.next_action: Promote identities into a visible commit strip and comparison rows. Use a graph only when ancestry data supports it.
limits: The ideal branch model is a source UI hint. It does not prove actual ancestry or current alignment.

findings.statement: PROD selection uses successful prod stages without an active rollback. It sorts by prod-stage finish time.
findings.consequence: Label the PROD reference with its deployment build and collected timestamp. Preserve unknown baselines.
findings.next_action: Label the PROD reference with its deployment build and collected timestamp. Preserve unknown baselines.
limits: Source selection is not deployment authorization. Live pipeline-stage semantics remain untested.

findings.statement: The supplied TSX embeds compliance audit cards, while the latest user request specifies direct Release Clinic linking.
findings.consequence: Use a direct Release Clinic entry in the proposed UI. Keep compliance findings owned by that report.
findings.next_action: Use a direct Release Clinic entry in the proposed UI. Keep compliance findings owned by that report.
limits: Latest explicit user intent takes priority for the proposal. This source behavior is preserved as historical evidence.

four_commit_labels.PROD: Commit from the selected qualifying deployed build.
four_commit_labels.Main: Latest main branch commit at collection.
four_commit_labels.Current build: Immutable sourceVersion used by the candidate pipeline build.
four_commit_labels.Latest: Latest commit of the candidate source branch at collection.

comparison_direction.candidate_latest: base=latest branch tip; target=candidate build sourceVersion
comparison_direction.candidate_main: base=main branch tip; target=candidate build sourceVersion
comparison_direction.candidate_prod: base=PROD deployed sourceVersion; target=candidate build sourceVersion
comparison_direction.main_prod: base=PROD deployed sourceVersion; target=main branch tip
